_about: Charles's knowledge-base benchmark: 72 questions a South African household might type, across the eight money areas and four money stages. Written blind on 2026-10-30, before the library rows were read. scripts/kb-coverage.ts counts a question answered when a row in the person's market, in the question's area, overlaps its words. Never tune a row to a question here without adding the real phrasing a person used. Each question is tagged with the money area a plan would file it under; a few tags were corrected on 2026-10-30 to the area the question actually belongs to (a stokvel is family money; a pension pot is the future), before any floor was set.
